decisions.reason: The semi-hard cheese wheel sits close to the core cheese range and was given its own page in 2019 while weaker launches were cut, so it appears to meet aspirations and calls for no problemistic search.

The spicy cheese survived the 2019 pruning that removed comparable flavoured variants and was promoted on its own page, which suggests acceptable performance in a growing industry where the firm's slack lets it carry the product.

The mild creamy soft cheese was highlighted at launch and retained with its own page when its sister soft cheese F was dropped, indicating it met expectations and fits the firm's narrow, trusted organic range.
